delivery.note: Generate genuine object and character motion first. Upscaling or interpolation cannot substitute for that motion. Review any upscaled/interpolated delivery separately.

common_prompt: Animate the supplied illustration as a real continuous anime film shot. Preserve the original art style, character identity, clothing, environment layout and color palette. Locked camera, no zoom, no cuts. Characters must perform anatomically coherent actions with weight transfer, articulated joints, contact with the ground and natural secondary motion. Vehicles translate through the scene along plausible paths; their reflections and shadows follow. Environmental motion is independent. No rubber-sheet warping of the still image, no stationary photo with a moving camera, no morphing faces, no melted architecture, no extra limbs, no captions, no watermark. Prioritize the specified main action over decorative particles.
review_requirements: The main action is visibly performed; reject mere camera movement, wobbling textures and particle overlays.
Inspect the entire clip at normal speed and frame by frame around hands, feet and object contact.
Character identity, anatomy, outfit and object counts remain consistent.
Movement follows scene perspective, gravity and occlusion; buildings remain rigid.
Loop only when continuity is natural. Never reverse walking or a departing train to fake a loop.
Do not replace shipped assets until the generated clip has passed review and its actual resolution/FPS are recorded.

scenes.name: Sakura Midnight
scenes.action_ru: Девушка делает несколько шагов по балкону, кладёт руку на перила и смотрит на город; внизу движется транспорт.
scenes.prompt: The woman takes two natural steps along the balcony toward the railing, rests her hand on it and turns her head toward the skyline. Her hair and coat follow her body motion. Small distant vehicles travel along the streets; sakura petals drift independently. Keep her face recognizable and the railing perfectly rigid.

scenes.name: Neon Tokyo
scenes.action_ru: Персонаж идёт по набережной; прохожие проходят мимо, отражения движутся вместе с людьми.
scenes.prompt: The foreground character walks slowly along the canal walkway with coordinated leg and arm motion and a natural shifting coat. Two small background pedestrians pass beneath the neon lights. Their reflections move with them in the wet pavement. Rain falls and the canal ripples while the buildings stay fixed.

scenes.name: Crimson Moon
scenes.action_ru: Девушка спускается по ступеням храма и ловит падающий лист; луна медленно вращается.
scenes.prompt: The woman carefully descends two stone steps, shifts her weight onto each planted foot, then raises a hand to catch a falling red leaf. Her long hair and clothing follow naturally. The red moon surface rotates slowly behind the fixed mountain silhouette; mist moves through the valley.

scenes.name: Aurora Voyage
scenes.action_ru: Парусник идёт по фьорду, оставляя след на воде; парус реагирует на ветер, сияние течёт по небу.
scenes.prompt: The existing sailboat travels steadily across the fjord, its hull rising gently with the waves and leaving a coherent wake. Its sail flexes with wind while the mast stays rigid. Reflections move with the boat; the aurora slowly flows across the sky. Snowy mountains remain stationary.

scenes.name: Astral Drift
scenes.action_ru: Астронавт отталкивается от обломка и дрейфует, корректируя положение тела; рядом вращаются камни.
scenes.prompt: The astronaut pushes away from a nearby fragment with one hand, drifts through space, then makes a small coordinated arm and leg adjustment to stabilize the body. Nearby debris slowly tumbles independently. The curved planet's cloud systems move beneath the astronaut. Preserve the spacesuit, visor and limb anatomy.

scenes.name: Golden Hour
scenes.action_ru: Поезд подъезжает к платформе и тормозит; сидящий пассажир встаёт и делает шаг к поезду.
scenes.prompt: An evening passenger train enters along the existing railway from the distant vanishing point and decelerates beside the platform. The seated person notices it, stands up using a believable weight shift, and takes one step toward the safe boarding area. Train wheels and carriages move as rigid connected objects and align exactly with the rails. Preserve the station geometry, sunset lighting and character identity. This is genuine train travel and a person standing and stepping, not a panning still image.

scenes.name: Rainy Ramen
scenes.action_ru: Прохожий идёт мимо раменной; внутри повар передаёт миску посетителю, в лужах расходятся круги.
scenes.prompt: A small pedestrian walks along the existing wet street past the ramen shop. Through the shop opening, a cook places a steaming bowl on the counter and a seated customer reaches to accept it. Keep these figures naturally sized for the architecture. Rain produces puddle ripples and the lanterns sway gently; shop walls remain rigid.

scenes.name: Ocean Sonata
scenes.action_ru: Персонаж плывёт среди руин и протягивает руку к медузе; медузы сокращаются и продвигаются в воде.
scenes.prompt: The underwater character makes a slow swimming stroke and extends one hand toward a nearby jellyfish without touching it. The jellyfish contracts its bell and moves forward through the water; its tentacles trail naturally. Hair and fabric respond to the current, and a few small fish swim past the rigid ruins.

scenes.name: Forest Shrine
scenes.action_ru: Лис проходит по тропе, нюхает землю и поворачивается к храму; хвост и уши двигаются естественно.
scenes.prompt: The fox walks several careful steps along the shrine path with a correct four-legged gait, lowers its muzzle to sniff, then looks toward the shrine. Its ears turn and its tail follows the body's motion. Fireflies move independently and foliage responds to a light breeze. Keep the shrine architecture fixed.

scenes.name: Skyline Racer
scenes.action_ru: Машина трогается и уезжает по мокрой дороге; колёса вращаются, блики и брызги следуют за ней.
scenes.prompt: The foreground sports car accelerates smoothly away along the existing wet road. Its wheels rotate in the correct direction, tires keep contact with the road, and reflected taillights move with the car. Small water sprays appear behind the tires. Distant traffic moves through the city; the camera and buildings stay still.

scenes.name: Cloud Sanctuary
scenes.action_ru: По мосту идут маленькие путники, птицы летят между островами; водопады непрерывно падают вниз.
scenes.prompt: Small naturally scaled travelers walk across an existing distant bridge between the floating structures. A pair of birds flap their wings and fly between the islands. Waterfalls flow downward continuously and clouds drift around, behind and beneath the islands. Preserve the island silhouettes and architectural layout.

scenes.name: Violet Horizon
scenes.action_ru: Девушка поворачивается к морю и опускает руку к воде; обе планеты вращаются, волны накатывают на берег.
scenes.prompt: The seated woman turns her head and upper body toward the ocean, shifts her weight naturally on the rock and lowers a hand toward the water beside her. Her hair moves independently in the wind. Both planets visibly rotate their surface features slowly inside fixed circular silhouettes, always behind the clouds and character. Waves advance onto the beach, break into foam and recede; reflections follow the water. Preserve her face and anatomy, and never warp the cliffs or the whole image.

scenes.name: Winter Letters
scenes.action_ru: Человек под зонтом идёт по снежной улице, оставляя следы, и поправляет зонт свободной рукой.
scenes.prompt: The person carrying the red umbrella walks slowly down the snow-covered village path with visible weight transfer and footprints appearing behind the feet. The free hand briefly adjusts the umbrella handle. Fabric sways, snow falls and chimney smoke rises. Keep the umbrella canopy coherent and the buildings still.

scenes.name: Ember Ronin
scenes.action_ru: Ронин идёт по каменным ступеням; рука придерживает ножны, плащ и листья движутся от ветра.
scenes.prompt: The ronin walks deliberately down the existing stone stairway, planting each foot on a separate step. One hand steadies the sheathed sword, while the cloak and hair react to movement and wind. Autumn leaves pass in front of and behind the figure. Preserve the sword, clothing and temple geometry; no combat or cuts.

scenes.name: Lo-Fi Atelier
scenes.action_ru: Художник рисует карандашом, поднимает взгляд и берёт кружку; за окном движется вечерний город.
scenes.prompt: The seated artist draws several deliberate pencil strokes on the page, pauses, looks toward the window and reaches for the nearby mug. Finger placement and contact with the pencil and mug remain anatomically coherent. Keep the desk objects in place. Distant city traffic moves and indoor plants sway very lightly.

scenes.name: Desert Mirage
scenes.action_ru: Караван идёт по гребню дюны; верблюды шагают, всадники покачиваются, за ними остаются следы.
scenes.prompt: The camel caravan advances along the existing dune ridge with coordinated four-legged walking cycles. Riders sway with the animals, cloth and packs move naturally, and footprints remain behind them in the sand. Fine sand drifts near the ground. Preserve the number of animals and riders and the distant city's rigid silhouette.

scenes.name: Electric Bloom
scenes.action_ru: Стеклянные лепестки раскрываются и поворачиваются, световые ленты проходят между ними, капли падают на поверхность.
scenes.prompt: The translucent glass flower's individual petals slowly unfold and turn around their attachment points as distinct three-dimensional objects. Luminous ribbons pass between the petals with correct occlusion, and a few droplets fall into the reflective surface, producing expanding ripples. Keep the glass material crisp; no global image distortion.

scenes.name: Moonlit Garden
scenes.action_ru: Девушка кормит рыб с края пруда; кои подплывают к руке и расходятся, водопад течёт непрерывно.
scenes.prompt: The seated woman leans slightly toward the pond and extends her hand to drop a small amount of fish food. The koi swim toward the falling food using visible tail and fin strokes, then turn and spread out, creating ripples. Her head follows the fish. The waterfall flows continuously and wisteria moves in the breeze. Preserve the girl's face, hand anatomy, bridge and buildings.
